definitions.full: H5741. Adriel עַדְרִיאֵל proper name, masculine son-in-law of Saul (apparently Aramaic name, my help is God = Hebrew עַזְרִיאֵל q. v.; so Ne Amos. Jour. Semitic Lang, xiii (1897), 173 HPS compare Gray Prop. N. 309 ; compare Old Aramaic יעדראל ClGann :J As,1883,Fev.-Mar.,139,No.13 ); — 1Sam 18:19 ( ᵐ5 A Ιηλ , ᵐ5 L Εδριηλ ), 2Sam 21:8 ( ᵐ5 Σερει , A Εσδρι , ᵐ5 L Εζρι ).

occurrences.englishText: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
